name: Mel's Drive-In
description: The most iconic restaurant at Universal Studios Singapore — Mel's Drive-In is a spectacular 1950s American diner on Hollywood Boulevard serving classic American food including burgers, hot dogs, milkshakes and loaded fries in a gorgeous chrome and neon atmosphere. A Universal Studios classic.

items.name: Classic Burger
items.description: Beef burger with cheese, lettuce, tomato and fries

items.name: Hot Dog
items.description: All-beef frankfurter in a toasted bun with mustard and ketchup

items.name: Milkshake
items.description: Thick creamy shake in chocolate, vanilla or strawberry

items.name: Chicken Tenders
items.description: Crispy chicken tenders with fries and dipping sauce

name: KT's Grill
description: A hearty American grill in the Lost World zone serving generous grilled burgers, chicken and international set meals — ideal for a substantial meal before tackling the big thrill rides.

items.description: Flame-grilled chicken with fries, coleslaw and sauce

items.name: Beef Burger Set

name: Louis NY Pizza Parlour
description: A classic New York-style pizza parlour on New York Street serving generously topped pizzas, pasta and Italian-American favourites in an authentic 1930s New York atmosphere — one of the most atmospheric dining spots at Universal Studios Singapore.

description: A quick-service food outlet in the Jurassic Park zone serving burgers, nuggets and snacks — ideal for a fast refuel between the Lost World and Ancient Egypt attractions.
